notes: Three complete selected skill directories plus three directly referenced support skills and their shared methods/bibliography, complete language templates, referenced executable examples and scaffold helper. Preserves relative layout. The surrounding heterogeneous AERS repository is not copied. Cross-navigation to unselected writing/submission/collection-maintenance material is recorded separately, not silently claimed as runtime closure.

execution: Python/R/Stata and method-specific packages as declared in templates and examples

externalActions: Research registration and openICPSR upload require user task authorization; source inclusion does not perform them
mutations: Template scaffold can replace destination contents with --replace; copied for inspection and not executed
limitations: Selected collection source MIT is preserved; example skeleton has its original template license and data-specific-license notice
Generated plans and documentation do not prove method validity, registration, reproducibility or journal compliance
